highlights.title: Hyundai to Buy SoftBank Boston Dynamics Stake in Robot Push
highlights.description: Hyundai Motor Co. and its affiliates are moving to acquire SoftBank Group Corp.’s remaining stake in the automaker’s Boston Dynamics unit, securing full ownership of the robotics pioneer at a steep discount as it prepares to deploy its Atlas humanoid robot on factory floors.

highlights.title: Alibaba and Baidu shares jump in Hong Kong on Apple AI partnership
highlights.description: The technological rivalry between China and the U.S. has intensified, as they race for AI dominance.

highlights.title: Japan to Buy Nvidia Rubin Chips to Build Sovereign AI for Robots
highlights.description: Japan is planning to buy 27,500 next-generation Rubin chips from Nvidia Corp. to build a homegrown foundational AI model for robots.

highlights.title: Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis calls for U.S. to spearhead AI standards body
highlights.description: Tech giant's AI boss said "urgent action" was needed as AI capabilities advanced.

highlights.title: TSMC Hikes Sales, Spending Outlook to Signal AI ‘Megatrend’
highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. raised its spending and revenue projections for the year, reflecting its confidence that torrid growth in demand for chips and data centers will extend into 2027.

highlights.title: Nvidia’s Huang Courts Japanese AI Suppliers With Pork Skewers
highlights.description: On Wednesday night, Jensen Huang was in Tokyo’s central Kanda district courting the little-known Japanese suppliers that underpin the AI supply chain.

highlights.title: Apple Store launches 2026 Back to School offer: get up to $150 gift card with Mac or iPad purchase
highlights.description: Apple today launched its Back to School deal for 2026. Students can get a gift card worth up to $150 with the purchase of a MacBook Pro. $100 gift cards are available with the purchase of MacBook Air, iPad Pro, and iPad Air. As is typical, you can usually save more money than the $150 gift card included in Apple’s promo by buying a new Mac from Amazon. However, it can still represent a reasonable deal for students who want to buy from the Apple Store directly.

highlights.description: TSMC announced a second-quarter profit, following its June revenue figures released earlier this week.

highlights.description: Fujitsu Ltd., Fanuc Corp. and two of Japan’s biggest robotics companies will work together in robot development, a move aimed at staying ahead of surging competition from China.

devices.title: Google and Epic Abandon Settlement, Clearing the Way for Rival Android App Stores
devices.description: Google and Epic Games this week withdrew their joint settlement agreement after it became clear the court was unlikely to allow it. With the settlement out, Google is bound by a permanent injunction issued in October 2024 requiring it to allow alternative app stores on Android devices. In a court filing [PDF], Google said that it plans to begin supporting alternative app stores on July 22. In a statement to The Verge, Google said it decided to withdraw the motion to avoid a prolonged legal fight
